Name: Alien Costume
Description: An inflatable alien costume. Acting as a replacement for bone armor, you can equip this item to look as silly as possible. Three varieties.

Name: Mortar Shell
Description: A high explosive mortar shell that deals minor structural damage on impact.

Name: Fragmentation Mortar Shell
Description: A fragmentation mortar shell, dealing lethal damage in a large area on impact.

Name: Apartment Key
Description: An old rusty key that can open the door to an apartment.

Name: Ballistic helmet
Description: Ballistic helmet with superior protection.

Name: Ballistic leg armour
Description: A pair of ballistic leg armour pieces. worn, used, and a bit grubby, but highly protective.

Name: Ballistic vest
Description: A standard issue military ballstic vest. Worn, used, and dirty, but highly protective.

Name: Metal Bar Stool
Description: Pull up a stool and have a drink. A decorative item which provides comfort while seated.

Name: Wooden Bar Stool
Description: Pull up a stool and have a drink. A decorative item which provides comfort while seated.

Name: #barricade.sandbags.half
Description: A protective barricade made out of Sand Bags. Deploy another one on top to build it higher, up to a sandbag pillbox.

Name: #barricade.sandbags.pillbox
Description: #barricade.sandbags.pillbox.desc

Name: #barricade.sandbags.three.quarter
Description: A protective barricade made out of Sand Bags. Deploy another one on top to build it higher, up to a sandbag pillbox.

Name: BDU pants
Description: A pair of standard issue battle dress uniform pants. Old, worn, stained, but provides moderate protection.

Name: BDU shirt
Description: A standard issue battle dress uniform shirt. Old, worn and stained, but provides moderate protection.

Name: Cooked Beef
Description: Delicious Beef, Eating it will restore some health, hunger, and thirst.

Name: Raw Beef
Description: Raw Beef. Eating it will damage your health, try cooking it first.

Name: Spoiled Beef
Description: Spoiled Beef. Consuming will damage your health.

Name: Blueprint Book
Description: A bound collection of precise schematics, used to research Workbench Level 3 items on the tech tree.

Name: Blueprint Fragment
Description:
Damaged diagrams containing partial information, used to research Workbench Level 1 items on the tech tree.

10 Blueprint Fragments can be pieced together to make a Blueprint Page.

Name: Blueprint Page
Description: A partially restored schematic page, used to research Workbench Level 2 items on the tech tree.

Name: Brioche Bread
Description: A loaf of rich brioche bread, eating it provides a large boost to health, hunger and hydration. Feeding to a horse will provide a boost to its digestion and dung production for a short time.

Name: Ronald McDonald House UK 2026 Plushie
Description:
A soft and squishy plush that provides comfort in your base. First sold on the Rust store in July 2026 to support Ronald McDonald House Charities UK, helping ease the burden on families by providing free ‘home away from home’ accommodation near hospitals.

www.rmhc.org.uk

Name: Cancer Research UK 2026 Plushie
Description:
A soft and squishy plush that provides comfort in your base.

Cancer Research UK (reg charity nos. 1089464, SC041666, 1103 and 247)
will get 100% of the net sales of the Cancer Research UK Plushie*.  

*Net sales being gross sales less refunds and after Steam platform fees (20%) and sales tax typically around 10-11%.

Name: Wool Armor Insert
Description: Wool insert for clothing and armour. Adds cold, melee and projectile protection.

Name: Cream
Description: The fat skimmed off whole milk. Calorie dense and restorative, but it will barely quench your thirst.

Name: Bowless Crossbow
Description: A bowless crossbow for fans of DIY

Name: Dart Board
Description: Throw some darts! Compete with others in a leaderboard. Hold the interact key to choose between a single or two-player game.

Name: Wumpus Plush
Description: Exclusive to the Rust Shop on Discord!

Name: Zombie Wumpus Plush
Description: Exclusive to the Rust Shop on Discord!

Name: White Boomer
Description: A very large mortar type firework with a white starburst

Name: Heavy Fuse
Description: Lasts longer than a regular fuse and is compatible with and able to restore a Power Plant. Will have to be replaced after a period of time.

Name: Bar Games Minifridge
Description: A small fridge you can store food into and keep your drink cool!

Name: Bar Games Shotgun Trap
Description: A shotgun trap triggered by movement, place near doorways and load with handmade shells.

Name: Biofuel Generator
Description: A large pot that can convert organic matter into fuel.

Name: Half Height Industrial Shelves
Description: Half height industrial shelves for stacking

Name: Halloween String Lights
Description: Spooky Halloween string lights for your base. Part of the Spooky Decor Bundle.

Name: Halloween Wreath
Description: A spooky Halloween Wreath for the doors in your base. Part of the Spooky Decor Bundle.

Name: Plague Doctor Hazmat Suit
Description: The Plague Doctor delivers no cure - only death and decay. Bring out your dead, or prepare to join them.

Name: Creamy Pure Healing Tea
Description: A pure healing tea, provides hydration and heals you a large amount over time. Enriched with cream for a stronger, shorter lived effect.

Name: Milky Pure Healing Tea
Description: A pure healing tea, provides hydration and heals you a large amount over time. Enriched with milk to make the effect last longer.

Name: Industrial Auto Turret
Description: This automated electric sentry turret will engage and neutralize any moving targets it has line of sight to. You must equip it with a projectile weapon and the corresponding ammunition. Note : The turret will search for targets in a 180 degree arc facing *you* when you place it. Requires 10 power.

Name: Industrial Electric Furnace
Description: An electrical version of a furnace that uses electricity instead of a fuel source.

Name: Large Industrial Furnace
Description: Used to smelt large quantities of ore. Difficult to secure, must be placed on terrain.

Name: Industrial Garage Door
Description: A garage door that rolls up and down.

Name: Industrial Storage Horizontal Barrel
Description: Horizontal barrel to store industrial materials

Name: Industrial Storage Vertical Barrel
Description: Vertical barrel to store industrial materials

Name: Industrial Torch
Description: An old mining lamp used as a torch. Lights your way at night and can be used as a weapon

Name: Jukebox
Description: A Jukebox that brings the tunes! Play recorded cassette tapes or stream audio from the internet. Fitted with a matrix display that shows the tuned station. Open the settings to change audio options.

Name: Gems
Description: Looks valuable

Name: M16A2
Description: A reliable burst-fire only rifle offering excellent accuracy and firerate.

Name: Creamy Pure Max Health Tea
Description: A pure health tea, provides hydration and temporarily boosts maximum health a large amount. Enriched with cream for a stronger, shorter lived effect.

Name: Milky Pure Max Health Tea
Description: A pure health tea, provides hydration and temporarily boosts maximum health a large amount. Enriched with milk to make the effect last longer.

Name: Medical Honey Bandage
Description: Heal yourself and others with this medical honey bandage. Left click heals you, right click heals others.

Name: Milk
Description: A small bottle of milk. Very calorie dense. Store in a fridge to separate it and create Cream.

Name: Mini Fridge
Description: Ideal for preserving food and keeping items cool.

Name: Mortar
Description: The Mortar fires in an arcing trajectory and favors volume over precision. Pairs well with binoculars.

Name: Cooked Mutton
Description: Delicious Mutton, Eating it will restore some health, hunger, and thirst.

Name: Raw Mutton
Description: Raw Mutton. Eating it will damage your health, try cooking it first.

Name: Spoiled Mutton
Description: Spoiled Mutton. Consuming will damage your health.

Name: Creamy Pure Ore Tea
Description: A pure ore tea, provides hydration and temporarily increases your yield when harvesting ores a large amount. Enriched with cream for a stronger, shorter lived effect.

Name: Milky Pure Ore Tea
Description: A pure ore tea, provides hydration and temporarily increases your yield when harvesting ores a large amount. Enriched with milk to make the effect last longer.

Name: Rich Apple Pie
Description: An apple pie enriched with cream. Provides a boost to hunger, health and hydration. Gives better night vision, including tree markings and ore hotspots, for a long time.

Name: Rich Bear Pie
Description: A bear meat pie enriched with cream. Provides a boost to hunger, health and hydration. Greatly increases effect of harvesting teas but reduces their duration.

Name: Beef Pie
Description: A pie made of beef, increases the maximum amount of food that can be eaten. High calorie consumption increases chance of recovering from injuries.

Name: Rich Beef Pie
Description: A pie made of beef, enriched with cream. Increases the maximum amount of food that can be eaten, up to double the normal amount. High calorie consumption increases chance of recovering from injuries.

Name: Rich Big Cat Pie
Description: A jungle cat pie enriched with cream, purrfect temperature. Boosts hunger, health and hydration. Shows nearby animal tracks for a long time.

Name: Rich Chicken Pie
Description: Just like mom used to make, enriched with cream. Provides a boost to hunger, health and hydration. Greatly increases the chance of better genes from crops for a short time.

Name: Rich Crocodile Pie
Description: A crocodile pie enriched with cream, may cause a reptile dysfunction. Causes most animals to fear the player and keep their distance for longer.

Name: Rich Fish Pie
Description: A delightful fish pie enriched with cream. Provides a boost to hunger, health and hydration. Increases base comfort level for a long time.

Name: Rich Hunters Pie
Description: A hunters pie enriched with cream, made with real deer. Provides a boost to hunger, health and hydration. Stops bleeding for a short time.

Name: Shepherds Pie
Description: Hearty mutton pie, provides a boost to hunger, health and hydration. Livestock grow used to you twice as fast, and are far less likely to turn on you, for a short time.

Name: Rich Shepherds Pie
Description: A hearty shepherds pie enriched with cream. Provides a boost to hunger, health and hydration. Livestock grow used to you far faster, and are far less likely to turn on you, for a short time.

Name: Rich Pork Pie
Description: A tempting pork pie enriched with cream. Provides a boost to hunger, health and hydration. Greatly improves healing rate from other sources for a short time.

Name: Rich Pumpkin Pie
Description: A spooky pumpkin pie enriched with cream. Provides a boost to health, hunger and hydration. Greatly increases maximum health for a short time.

Name: Pool Table
Description: A classic game of pool to challenge your friends, or foes. Hold the interact key to choose between a single or two-player game.

Name: Creamy Pure Cooling Tea
Description: A pure cooling tea that temporarily decreases your max and core temperature. Enriched with cream for a stronger, shorter lived effect.

Name: Milky Pure Cooling Tea
Description: A pure cooling tea that temporarily decreases your max and core temperature. Enriched with milk to make the effect last longer.

Name: Creamy Pure Harvesting Tea
Description: A pure harvesting tea, provides hydration and temporarily increases the amount of resources you receive from harvesting corpses a large amount. Enriched with cream for a stronger, shorter lived effect.

Name: Milky Pure Harvesting Tea
Description: A pure harvesting tea, provides hydration and temporarily increases the amount of resources you receive from harvesting corpses a large amount. Enriched with milk to make the effect last longer.

Name: Creamy Pure Warming Tea
Description: A pure warming tea that temporarily increases both your core and minimum temperature. Enriched with cream for a stronger, shorter lived effect.

Name: Milky Pure Warming Tea
Description: A pure warming tea that temporarily increases both your core and minimum temperature. Enriched with milk to make the effect last longer.

Name: Creamy Pure Anti-Rad Tea
Description: A pure tea that provides hydration and temporarily increases your resistance to radiation a large amount. Enriched with cream for a stronger, shorter lived effect.

Name: Milky Pure Anti-Rad Tea
Description: A pure tea that provides hydration and temporarily increases your resistance to radiation a large amount. Enriched with milk to make the effect last longer.

Name: Crystal Assault Rifle Sapphire
Description: Machined from the toughest gemstones, this Assault Rifle skin will show each and every shot you take.

Name: Crystal Assault Rifle Emerald
Description: Machined from the toughest gemstones, this Assault Rifle skin will show each and every shot you take.

Name: Crystal Assault Rifle Pink Diamond
Description: Machined from the toughest gemstones, this Assault Rifle skin will show each and every shot you take.

Name: Crystal Assault Rifle Diamond
Description: Machined from the toughest gemstones, this Assault Rifle skin will show each and every shot you take.

Name: Crystal Assault Rifle Ruby
Description: Machined from the toughest gemstones, this Assault Rifle skin will show each and every shot you take.

Name: Salvaged Industrial Shelves
Description: Shelves for item stacking

Name: Creamy Pure Scrap Tea
Description: A pure scrap tea, temporarily increases the amount of scrap you receive from barrels a large amount. Enriched with cream for a stronger, shorter lived effect.

Name: Milky Pure Scrap Tea
Description: A pure scrap tea, temporarily increases the amount of scrap you receive from barrels a large amount. Enriched with milk to make the effect last longer.

Name: Stone Sculpture
Description: A block of stone you can sculpt.

Name: Shears
Description: Used to shear wool from sheep. More effective than other weapons and will never hurt a sheep.

Name: Skimmed Milk
Description: Milk with the cream separated out. Hydrating, but less calorie dense than whole milk.

Name: Uzi
Description: A compact, fast-firing machine pistol. Hold [+firemode] to extend the stock for better control.

Name: Thruster Module
Description: A thruster module salvaged from crashed satellite remains. The more fuel left in the satellite when it was brought down, the better its condition.

Name: Skull Wall Lamp
Description: Turn your enemies into something useful with this tasteful lamp.

Name: Animal Fence Gate
Description: A gate for accessing your animal pen.

Name: Animal Fence
Description: A sturdy fence for penning animals.

Name: Industrial Wall Shelves
Description: A shallow industrial wall shelf for small item stacking

Name: Creamy Pure Wood Tea
Description: A pure wood tea, temporarily increases the yield from cutting trees a large amount. Enriched with cream for a stronger, shorter lived effect.

Name: Milky Pure Wood Tea
Description: A pure wood tea, temporarily increases the yield from cutting trees a large amount. Enriched with milk to make the effect last longer.

Name: Wool
Description: A bundle of wool. Might be able to take this to a stable to sell.

Name: Accelerated Workbench Upgrade
Description: Crafting speed increases by 25% for each item already completed in the same batch.

Name: Comfort Workbench Upgrade
Description: Provides a 100% comfort zone around the workbench for those long crafting sessions.

Name: Defensive Workbench Upgrade
Description: Armor or clothing compatible with insert slots will roll an additional slot when crafted using this upgrade.

Name: Efficiency Workbench Upgrade
Description: 10% chance to produce a free bonus item when crafting in batches. Ineffective when crafting explosive and raid related items.

Name: Prototype Workbench Upgrade
Description: Allows unlocking any tech tree item regardless of progression. Each attempt has a 25% chance to succeed, and a failed attempt still consumes resources.

Name: Range Workbench Upgrade
Description: Doubles the workbench crafting radius, letting you craft from twice as far away.

Name: Recycle Bin Workbench Upgrade
Description: Crafting at a workbench with this upgrade has a chance to refund up to 10% of the ingredient costs back to you in raw material form.

Name: Reinforced Workbench Upgrade
Description: Increases the workbench's max HP by 150% and grants explosive damage resistance.

Name: Salvage Workbench Upgrade
Description: Each blueprint spent on tech tree unlocks at this bench has a 20% chance to not be consumed.

Name: Surplus Workbench Upgrade
Description: 20% chance to produce a random surplus part (1-8) when crafting. Surplus parts are used in special alternate recipes.
